sentences.en: The prison perimeter is denoted by a large fence.
sentences.zh: 监狱的周界由一个大围栏标示。

sentences.en: No unauthorised persons will be permitted inside the perimeter.
sentences.zh: 未经许可的人不允许进入该区域。

sentences.en: Yanni decided to scout the perimeter.
sentences.zh: Yanni决定侦查一下周边的情况。

senses.zh: 周边;周围;边缘形容词: perimetric

mnemonic: 词根记忆：peri（周围）+meter（测量）→周长
